trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: Provide lead ID and state urgency.
steps.text: ஹலோ, எனக்கு கொஞ்சம் அவசரம், சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க. என் lead id LD-2004.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the urgency and clarify the reason for calling.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா சார், நான் help பண்றேன். நீங்க உங்க booking பத்தி கேட்க call பண்ணிருக்கீங்களா?

steps.purpose: State the payment made, ask about refund, and provide name.
steps.text: ஆமா. நான் நேத்து 50000 token amount pay பண்ணிட்டேன். அது full refund ஆகுமான்னு தெரிஞ்சுக்கணும். என் பேரு Karthik.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details to verify the user's claims.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the booking details using the provided lead ID.
steps.planner_rationale: The user provided a lead ID and asked about their token payment, so the booking details must be retrieved.

steps.purpose: Return the booking details.
Verify the customer's identity before disclosing booking information.
Return the verification outcome.
Inform the user of verification failure and ask for an alternative factor.
steps.text: Karthik, உங்க name எங்களோட records-ல match ஆகல. உங்களுக்கு அவசரம்னு புரியுது, security-க்காக உங்க date of birth இல்லனா registered pincode சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide alternative verification factors.
steps.text: Oh, என் wife name-ல register பண்ணிருப்பேன், அவ பேரு Divya. Date of birth 15th May. சீக்கிரம் சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Verify identity using the newly provided factors.
Return the successful verification outcome.
Confirm verification and correct the user's assumption about the payment.
steps.text: Thank you, unit A-0902-க்கான verification successful. நீங்க 50000 pay பண்ணதா சொன்னீங்க, ஆனா system-ல amount paid 0 னு காட்டுது.

steps.purpose: Express surprise at the zero amount and ask about refund policy.
steps.text: என்னது 0 வா? சரி, payment fail ஆகிருக்கும். நான் திரும்ப pay பண்றேன். But ஒருவேளை நான் cancel பண்ணா, அந்த 50000 full refund கிடைக்குமா? I have another call to take.
steps.clean_text: என்னது 0 வா? சரி, payment fail ஆகிருக்கும். நான் திரும்ப pay பண்றேன். But ஒருவேளை நான் cancel பண்ணா, அந்த 50000 full refund கிடைக்குமா? I have another call to take.

steps.purpose: Check the refund eligibility to answer the user's question.
steps.expected_behavior: Check the refund eligibility for the booking reference.
steps.planner_rationale: The user asked if their payment would be fully refunded upon cancellation, requiring a policy check.

steps.purpose: Return the refund eligibility rules.

result.reason: Token amount is fully deducted upon cancellation before allotment.

steps.purpose: Correct the user's assumption about getting a full refund.
steps.text: இல்ல சார், அது full refund ஆகாது. Policy படி 50000 deduction ஆகும், அதனால refundable amount 0 தான்.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the deduction and ask for the current allotment status.
steps.text: Oh, full deduction ஆகுமா. சரி, இப்போ allotment status என்னவா இருக்கு?

steps.purpose: Provide the current allotment status.
steps.text: இப்போதைக்கு allotment status 'none' னு இருக்கு சார், அதாவது இன்னும் allot ஆகல.

steps.purpose: Ask a hypothetical question about refund if allotment is confirmed.
steps.text: Okay, அப்போ allotment confirm ஆனா refund கிடைக்குமா?

steps.purpose: Explain the rule for confirmed allotments.
steps.text: Confirmed allotment-க்கு agreement-ல இருக்க cancellation terms தான் follow பண்ணுவோம், token policy கிடையாது.

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
steps.text: Okay, நான் யோசிச்சுட்டு call பண்றேன். Thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told why the booking is not refundable and on what terms.
